blind_spots.blind_spot: A 'Global Persistent Awareness' fusion platform (LiDAR + imagery + RF) is pitched around 'cloud-based visualization,' the same cloud dependency as their commercial product, with no edge-processing or offline mode described
blind_spots.operator_reality: Persistent-awareness mapping in a contested urban environment needs to keep functioning when uplink to the cloud is denied or degraded; if the fusion and visualization pipeline requires cloud roundtrips, the system goes blind exactly when persistent awareness matters most
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the architecture was built for civilian infrastructure survey work, where cloud connectivity is a given, and appears to have been proposed for the DoD use case largely as-is
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Powerful Visualization: Cloud-based geospatial platforms make mobile mapping data and digital infrastructure models easy to access and use.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The mobile mapping 'fleet' (RIEGL LiDAR, GNSS, 360° imagery on survey vehicles) has no SWaP-C story for expeditionary or 'Resilient Basing' use beyond civilian survey vans
blind_spots.operator_reality: Resilient basing and forward infrastructure mapping often can't rely on a full survey-van sensor suite; without a ruggedized, smaller-footprint variant, the SBIR concept may never leave the commercial-platform form factor it was designed around
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the sensor package and workflow are proven for commercial telecom/utility surveys, and adapting SWaP-C for a base-resilience use case is a separate, unaddressed engineering problem
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Our scalable mobile mapping fleet enables rapid data collection across highways, utility corridors, urban environments, and transportation networks

blind_spots.blind_spot: No ATO/RMF, ITAR, or data-handling story for a platform that explicitly fuses Radio Frequency (RF) data with imagery to map devices and networks — a SIGINT-adjacent capability
blind_spots.operator_reality: RF collection and network-mapping data is sensitive by nature; a system built for commercial geospatial workflows needs a real accreditation and data-handling plan before a program office will let it anywhere near an operational RF dataset, and none is visible in either the commercial site or the (truncated) SBIR abstract
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the abstract available in this pack is cut off after one sentence, suggesting the security/compliance plan — if it exists — isn't part of the public-facing pitch
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Teleqo Tech proposes to research and develop a platform to fuse existing, non-proprietary LiDAR, imagery and Radio Frequency (RF) data sets from mobile and static sources to map out smart cities devices and networks in urban, clustered environments.

opener_hook: Teleqo's Global Persistent Awareness SBIR fuses LiDAR, imagery, and RF data through a cloud-based visualization platform — what's the plan when the environment denies that cloud link?
what_they_do: A commercial mobile LiDAR/geospatial mapping services company for telecom, utility, and transportation infrastructure, now applying the same sensor-fusion approach to an Air Force SBIR for smart-cities 'Global Persistent Awareness' and resilient-basing infrastructure digitization.
